en: Black‑and‑white street scene in a European small town or suburb, likely mid‑20th century. A narrow paved street with a pedestrian crossing runs into the background where low two‑story houses stand. On the left is a small utility or delivery vehicle with several men on board; a bicycle with a trailer and various pedestrians are visible. Old cars are parked along the street. On the right side is a larger building with signage and a child standing near the wall. Mature trees line the road, giving the scene a leafy, peaceful atmosphere.
